summary: McGraw Mountain: 1934 pole-tower lookout replaced by an 82-ft timber tower (1964 or 1965); staffed until 1972, now called abandoned; still listed standing.

facts.design: R-6 14x14 flat-top cab on an 82-ft open timber tower; the 1934 station was a 14x14 L-4 cab on a 10-ft pole tower
facts.status_note: Listed as standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; firelookout.com calls it presently abandoned on an undated page
facts.agency: US Forest Service, Wallowa-Whitman National Forest

staffing.status: unstaffed; staffed until 1972 per firelookout.com (undated page)

events.note: Fire detection on the site since at least 1930; an August 1930 item names Cleve Loyd as lookout patrolman at McGraw
10-ft pole tower with a 14x14 L-4 cab, the first station on the site
June 1944 notice: Kenneth Blevans to be lookout at McGraw that summer and fall
Forest Service announced a new tower and house (June 1964); contract to Cook & Sorenson of Seattle, apparent low bid of $5,840 (August 1964); old tower declared obsolete and inadequate
firelookout.com dates the present 82-ft tower to 1964, built half a mile from the 1934 location
NHLR and Forest Lookouts date the present 82-ft tower to 1965
Local paper reports the lookout quite busy due to fires in the district
firelookout.com: staffed until 1972 and has seen only limited use since

corrections.why: NHLR describes an 82-foot open timber tower and firelookout.com gives 82' for the present tower (about 25 m). No source supports 3 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1964 for the present tower, built half a mile from the 1934 site; NHLR and Forest Lookouts give 1965. The 1964 Forest Service announcement and contract support a 1964-65 construction window. The record keeps 1965 as the built event and records 1964 separately.
NHLR gives 6,009 ft (1,832 m); firelookout.com gives 6020'. The record keeps the NHLR figure (1831.5 m).

The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as standing; firelookout.com calls it presently abandoned on an undated page. Both are recorded: the structure stands, and the tower is not in regular use.
Forest Lookouts names Cleve Loyd (1930-31 item); firelookout.com lists I.C. Loyd for 1931-1936. Not resolved; the story does not name either man for those years.

notes_for_editor: Brief's registration date (July 4, 2022) and registry numbers US 1633 / OR 151 are confirmed on the NHLR page. Brief's height_m of 3.0 is wrong; corrected to 25.0. No access level is recorded: no source read says whether the public can visit or climb the tower, so the access key is omitted. A search snippet mentioned a Hells Canyon MVUM legend with a Cabin Rental entry near Imnaha; it was not tied to McGraw and was not read, so it is not used. The 1930s staffing name differs between sources (Cleve Loyd vs I.C. Loyd). Firelookout.com's abandoned statement is undated. Reads: 4 pages (NHLR, firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts, FFLA standing list); 2 web searches.
